text: Close your eyes and bring to mind the Devi in today's alankaram.
Meditate quietly for a few moments, then join your hands and bow.
Meditate on Durga, who protects her devotees.
The verse means: May the Mother of the worlds, who slew Madhu and Kaitabha, Mahishasura, Chanda and Munda, Raktabija, Shumbha and Nishumbha, protect us.
